original.hook: There's a tiny magnet hidden in these socks.
original.first_line: And it fixes the most annoying chore in my house.
original.core_promise: A tiny magnet on the cuffs keeps each sock pair together through the washer and dryer, so socks stop getting lost, and a quiz gets you 5 pairs for $29.

variants.hook: Watch what happens when these two socks touch.
variants.first_line: Yep, that's a magnet. And it fixed the most annoying chore in my house.
variants.visual_idea: Phone close-up of two hands holding socks a few inches apart, then letting go so the cuffs snap together.
variants.rationale: Instant visual payoff makes viewers wait to see the snap, and demo is our top-performing angle.

variants.hook: I stopped sorting socks. Here's the weird reason.
variants.first_line: Turns out the secret is a tiny magnet on the cuff.
variants.visual_idea: Person sitting next to a laundry basket, shrugging at the camera and holding up one sock without showing the cuff yet.
variants.rationale: A weird reason is promised but withheld, so viewers stay for the answer.

variants.hook: Another laundry day, another sock gone missing.
variants.first_line: I got so tired of it that I tried socks with a magnet.
variants.visual_idea: Handheld shot of a person staring into an empty dryer with one lonely sock in hand.
variants.rationale: It names a frustration the viewer already knows, and the visual shows it in one glance.

variants.hook: POV: every sock comes out of the dryer paired.
variants.first_line: Sounds fake, I know. It used to be the opposite in my house.
variants.visual_idea: First-person view of hands pulling warm laundry out of the dryer, with sock pairs clinging together.
variants.rationale: A first-person moment shows the dream outcome, and the next line admits it sounds too good.

variants.hook: Three places I used to search for one missing sock.
variants.first_line: Now I search zero places. Tiny magnets on the cuffs keep each pair together.
variants.visual_idea: Person holds up three fingers to the camera, then points toward a dryer, a bed, and a backpack in quick cuts.
variants.rationale: A concrete count from everyday life feels instantly familiar and sets up the fix.

variants.hook: My sister watched my socks snap together and said, "What?!"
variants.first_line: Same reaction I had. A tiny magnet on the cuff fixed my laundry problem.
variants.visual_idea: Selfie shot of the creator next to a friend or sister whose jaw drops as the socks snap together.
variants.rationale: A real person's surprised reaction creates curiosity and makes the claim feel credible.

variants.hook: Your dryer isn't eating socks. They're just not attached.
variants.first_line: So I got socks that stay attached. A tiny magnet on the cuffs does it.
variants.visual_idea: Creator pats the dryer door like it's been wrongly accused, then holds up a magnetically paired set of socks.
variants.rationale: It flips the usual blame onto a new cause, which makes viewers pause to find out what it means.

variants.hook: What if your socks just stayed together in the wash?
variants.first_line: Mine do, because there's a tiny magnet hidden in the cuff.
variants.visual_idea: Creator holds a pair over an open washer and raises an eyebrow at the camera before dropping them in.
variants.rationale: It asks a wish the viewer says yes to, then answers right away.

variants.hook: Watch me pull this pair out of the dryer.
variants.first_line: Here's the thing: it's a tiny magnet in the cuff, and it fixed my laundry day.
variants.visual_idea: Phone shot of the creator opening the dryer, reaching into warm laundry, and lifting out a pair still stuck together.
variants.rationale: It sets up a clear moment to watch, and the payoff is the product's core promise.

variants.hook: Something in this sock cuff changed my laundry day.
variants.first_line: It's a tiny magnet, and now my pairs come out of the wash together.
variants.visual_idea: Extreme close-up of a thumb running along a sock cuff while the creator whispers like they're sharing a secret.
variants.rationale: A hidden detail with an open question keeps viewers watching for the reveal.
